# JoeyC.ai

> Joey Colley builds apps, websites and automations with AI and shows how. Self-taught, not a traditional developer; ships with Claude, Lovable and Replit and documents it in public.

Canonical site: https://www.joeyc.ai
Blog: https://www.joeyc.ai/blog (RSS: https://www.joeyc.ai/rss.xml, sitemap: https://www.joeyc.ai/sitemap.xml)

## Projects

- Luxvibe.io (https://luxvibe.io): AI-powered luxury hotel booking platform that matches travelers with curated stays using intelligent recommendations. React, LiteAPI, Claude AI.
- Content Studio (https://www.joeyc.ai/command-center, invite-only): AI content generation command center; turn one idea into posts, blogs, threads and video scripts across every platform. React, Claude API, Supabase.
- TitiActriz.com (https://titiactriz.com): Actress portfolio and personal brand site with a cinematic aesthetic and dynamic content management. React, Supabase.
- TitiLINKS (https://titilinks.com): Bio link SaaS built for TikTok creators; one link, every platform, fully customizable. React, Supabase, Framer Motion.
- Field Report AI (https://fieldreportai.app): AI-powered field reporting tool that turns raw observations into structured, professional reports. React, Claude API.
- Spanish Chat App (https://medellin-chatter.lovable.app): Conversational Spanish learning app; practice real dialogue with an AI tutor that adapts to your level. React, AI, Lovable.
